historical_evidence_hierarchy: exact provider historical revision bytes plus provider timestamp and content hash
content-addressed official snapshot containing the exact root plus extraction proof
independent archive capture of the exact provider metadata response with timestamp and digest
provider creation/deposit/index timestamp only, which is identity evidence but not byte provenance
history_positive_condition: For each Crossref DOI, an exact pre-cutoff metadata object is extracted from a provider or independent content-addressed archive with timestamp, digest, and identity proof.
questions: Can exact pre-cutoff Crossref metadata bytes be bound to every article root through official snapshots, public files, deposit evidence, or independent content-addressed archives?
Can metadata, body/file/code, issue/comment, documentation, and attachment rights be bound separately for every root without opening candidate content?
rights_positive_condition: Every intended acquired content class has a root-bound authoritative permission and acquisition policy compatible with the frozen use; uploader/depositor authority ambiguities are separately closed.

rights_status_vocabulary.ACCESS_ONLY_NOT_REUSE: The provider permits or exposes acquisition but gives no root-bound reuse grant for this content class.
rights_status_vocabulary.CANNOT_CHECK: The evidence does not establish the content-class right, historical bytes, or scope.
rights_status_vocabulary.DECLARED_PERMISSION_AUTHORITY_UNVERIFIED: The provider requires a declaration and the record supplies one, but uploader/depositor authority or byte scope is not independently established.
rights_status_vocabulary.NOT_ACCESSED: The content class remained unopened and unarchived.
rights_status_vocabulary.ROOT_BOUND_PERMISSION: An authoritative root-bound licence or policy covers the named content class; this is not a legal opinion or case-eligibility finding.

robots_boundary: robots.txt is an acquisition/crawling directive, not copyright permission, a content licence, case eligibility, or scientific authority
